## Summary

## Validation

## Protocol impact

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated files.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, wallet material, or populated environment files are included.
- [ ] Public copy contains no internal notes or release instructions.
- [ ] Documentation and deployment records are updated where applicable.
